title: Transition ducts.
officialText:
Transition ducts used to connect the dryer to the exhaust duct system shall be a single length that is listed
and labeled in accordance with UL 2158A. Transition ducts shall be a maximum of 8 feet (2438 mm) in length and shall not be
concealed within construction.
